matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the placement of the BC term inside the indicator function in Equation 1, preventing BC loss during warm-up. None of the findings address this specific structural issue in the objective function; pred_id 5 discusses a different inconsistency about the alpha parameter vs lambda coefficient.
GT2 concerns the undefined derivative r'_{t−i} in Equation 7's adaptive slope scheduler. None of the findings discuss Equation 7 or the adaptive scheduling mechanism at all.

GT3 concerns the soft-reset mechanism in Equation 4 and the inconsistency between the mathematical formulation (subtraction outside vs inside the decay term) and its physical interpretation. None of the findings address Equation 4 or the spiking neuron reset mechanism.
